holderQuote: A Potion of healing. Yvlon felt the pain receding and managed to pull herself to her knees. She saw—dizzy, coughing up blood—Mectail reach down. He picked up his hand, and the Stitch-Man held it to the bleeding stump. Then, grimacing, he spoke.
effectQuote: She saw a line of stitches knit themselves, sewing his hand back onto his arm.
